## Is your request related to a problem?

A clear description of the problem. For example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Describe the solution you'd like

What you want to happen.

## Alternatives you've considered

Any other approaches or workarounds you've tried.

## Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, or links that help explain the request. If this depends on a feature of the Immich server, mention the server version.
